name: Git
description: Your vault as a git repository: a Source control panel to stage, commit, pull and push, each file's diff and its history of commits, and commit-and-sync on a timer or after you stop editing. Runs your git on the server's machine, talking to the remotes you set up.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: When the vault is a git repository (`git_status`), commit your own work with `git_commit` (files: the ones you changed, message: what you did); `git_sync` pulls and pushes it.

autoIdle.label: Commit and sync after editing stops
autoIdle.description: minutes without a change in the vault before an automatic commit-and-sync (0: off)

message.label: Commit message
message.description: for commits without one: {{date}}, {{numFiles}}, {{hostname}} and {{files}} are filled in

dateFormat.label: Date format
dateFormat.description: how {{date}} is written: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss

push.label: Push when syncing
push.description: commit and sync pushes after pulling; off: it only commits and pulls

stageAll.label: Commit everything when nothing is staged
stageAll.description: Commit stages every change first when none is staged

machine.label: Machine for automatic syncs
machine.description: which machine runs them, by its id in Machines (empty: the first listed)

authorName.label: Author name
authorName.description: the name on commits, when git on the server's machine has none

authorEmail.label: Author email
authorEmail.description: the email on commits, when git on the server's machine has none
